answer.reason: The verses tell of Sheba's revolt against David and his death at Abel of Bethmaachah.

clauses.english: blew a trumpet and led Israel away from David
clauses.quote: every man to his tents, O Israel

clauses.english: was besieged in Abel of Bethmaachah and beheaded by its people, who threw his head to Joab
clauses.quote: they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab

doubts: 2SA 20:1 calls him a Benjamite while 2SA 20:21 says a man of mount Ephraim; the summary already gives Ephraim, so it is not used in a clause.
